name: Fake Bitcoin BSC Token
rootCause: On Oct 10, a fake Bitcoin BSC Token (BTCBSC) on BSC was rugged for ~$48.7K. The deployer removed 235.871 WBNB and 4,271,589.56 BTCBSC token from the LP. Contract Address: 0x48747d325d139b1F9cD29d9381Fb73228B9AFfec. Deployer Address: 0xA51EA8e037e0a1A391A39Bc8b5CE1EC6533780Df.
